gates.name: Ruff lint
gates.notes: Ratcheted after adding pre-commit; 24 pre-existing violations fixed 2026-09-03.

gates.name: Pytest suite
gates.scope: tests/ (658 tests · 10 suites incl. dedicated E2E card)
gates.notes: pytest --forked isolates provider mocks per-test. 3m01s at HEAD. New end-to-end suite covers the 3-level model chain reaching the wire; new admin_ui suite covers inherit-toggle write-paths.

gates.name: License scan (§12)
gates.notes: pip-licenses + allowlist + explicit LGPL/dual-license exceptions. pypdfium2 exception documents the atypical compound license string.

gates.name: Tenant-scope audit
gates.notes: Direct tenant-scoped queries without a tenant_id filter within 40 lines are blocked. Suppression via inline # tenant-audit: allow.

gates.name: Alembic upgrade head (fresh DB)
gates.notes: Regression guarded by 0025 seed-filter (only kinds allowed by the migration's own CHECK constraint).

gates.name: Pre-commit hooks
gates.notes: Ruff + hygiene + tenant-scope audit run on every commit. License scan CI-only (pip-licenses false-fails in shared venvs).

boundary_tests.name: docgen never imports pap_pipeline
boundary_tests.purpose: Proves the substrate has no back-reference to the submission-window pipeline. Reviewers can strip pap_pipeline without breaking Quire.

boundary_tests.name: core never imports AI providers
boundary_tests.purpose: Enforces 'no model at render time'. If the deterministic render path ever imports docgen.providers, the build fails.

boundary_tests.name: No LLM in reply path
boundary_tests.purpose: Reply-letter template must be merge-time fill only. No stage between decision and outbound bytes may call a model.

boundary_tests.name: Nebius default targets NVIDIA Nemotron
boundary_tests.purpose: Hackathon requirement: the default model name must start with nvidia/. Regression guard on the compliance claim.

audits.name: Triage + 3-level config chain review
audits.outcome: 4 blockers found, all fixed at HEAD. Route allowlist added to both routing_json POST handlers; dead routing-clobber code removed from program_models_save; inbound email subject now threaded to Triage classifier; bare assert replaced with explicit guard in _llm_classify (safe under python -O).

audits.name: Multi-tenancy scope
audits.outcome: Passing on all in-scope models. 4 file-level suppressions justified (admin portal + 3 worker actors).

audits.name: Caller-profile mapping engine threat model
audits.outcome: No eval / injection path. Closed grammar via strict regex; explicit-dispatch transforms; no dynamic attribute access.

audits.name: N+1 audit (dashboard + templates)
audits.outcome: No true N+1 found. Fixed one wasted tenant re-query in _base_ctx.

review_notes.note: PDF placement editor is the placement editor's hot path. Page rasterisation is cached to blob storage keyed by version hash.
review_notes.action: Monitor cache hit rate once telemetry ships.

review_notes.note: Reason stage runs Nemotron in non-reasoning mode deliberately; reasoning variant burns output tokens on trace and returns empty content.
`_forbid_raw_history_events(extras)` runs on reason-stage entry. Rules pack, not the LLM, decides how history matters.
review_notes.action: Keep boundary. CI test in ADR-0004 PR6 will enforce.

review_notes.note: 0025 seeds only kinds allowed by its own CHECK constraint; later kinds (history) seeded by their own migration after the constraint widens.
review_notes.action: Repeat pattern for any new kind. Never widen 0025's seed.

review_notes.note: MinIO pulls from quay.io, not docker.io. Shared runner IPs hit Docker Hub anonymous rate limits.
review_notes.action: Keep quay mirror for the MinIO + mc images.

review_notes.note: Public framing scrub: README/demo/video may not name specific competitors or libraries the submission is compared against.
review_notes.action: Memory rule enforced during any README edit.

review_notes.note: Duplicate helpers `_lookup_program_row` and `_load_program_row` (byte-identical) in src/pap_pipeline/inbox_hook.py:628,716. Both are called per case, doubling the DB round-trip in the happy path.
review_notes.action: Consolidate to a single function and thread the resolved Program row through `_draft_reply_artifact` instead of re-fetching.

review_notes.note: src/docgen/ui/routes.py:5857-5860 hardcodes `extract_model="openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5"` and `reason_model="nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b"` on program creation, so env-var-driven default rotation never propagates to newly created programs.
review_notes.action: Seed with `None` (fall back to settings) or read from `get_settings()` at create time.

review_notes.note: Landing CSP was missing `media-src 'self'` after the demo card switched from YouTube iframe to a local <video>. Strict browsers would refuse to play. Also carried dead `frame-src youtube-nocookie` allowances.
review_notes.action: FIXED 2026-09-16: landing_csp now emits `media-src 'self'` and drops the YouTube frame-src entries. Verified via `curl -I /`.

review_notes.note: orchestrator.run_with_intake stacks extract_findings before verifier_findings intentionally (extraction disagreements read first). Undocumented in the code.
review_notes.action: Add a one-line comment noting the ordering is intentional so a future reviewer doesn't reorder.

review_notes.note: src/docgen/ui/routes.py previously wrote prog.triage_routing on every Models-tab save with a dead form-field lookup (`route_{case_type}`) that never matched anything, silently clearing operator-set routing overrides.
review_notes.action: FIXED 2026-09-17: removed the routing block from program_models_save; the dedicated Triage tab now owns routing writes.

review_notes.note: Both admin_save_tenant_triage_routing and program_triage_routing_save accepted arbitrary `route` strings from routing_json and persisted them to JSONB. A hand-crafted POST could inject values outside the UI's <select> vocabulary.
review_notes.action: FIXED 2026-09-17: introduced _TRIAGE_ROUTES tuple as the single source of truth; both POST handlers now allowlist-check `route` before insert.

review_notes.note: _handler resolved the inbound email `subject` on the InboxEvent but never forwarded it to _run_pipeline. The Triage LLM classifier treats subject as its highest-precedence signal, so every production case was classifying against extras+intake only.
review_notes.action: FIXED 2026-09-17: _run_pipeline gained a `subject` kwarg and _handler now threads msg.subject through to run_with_intake.

review_notes.note: _llm_classify used `assert config.base_url and config.api_key and config.model` as a runtime precondition. `python -O` compiles asserts out, breaking the documented fallback contract (return None on missing creds).
review_notes.action: FIXED 2026-09-17: replaced with an explicit `if not (…): return None`.

review_notes.note: Duplicate helpers _lookup_program_row and _load_program_row (byte-identical) still cause two DB round-trips per case in the happy path. Consolidation deferred so this review round stays focused on the Triage / config-chain surface.
review_notes.action: Queued: consolidate to a single function and thread the resolved Program row through _draft_reply_artifact instead of re-fetching.

conventions.rule: One-way import direction: pap_pipeline → docgen. Never reverse.
Tenant-scoped queries carry a tenant_id filter within 40 lines.
LGPL/dual-license deps enter EXPLICIT_EXCEPTIONS with justification, never the general allowlist.
Migrations seed only kinds allowed by their own CHECK constraint; kinds added later are seeded by their own migration.
Public-facing framing (README, demo, video) scrubs specific competitors and prior-employer libraries.
